_comment: v6 global multi-region training set. bbox = [minlon, minlat, maxlon, maxlat]. catalog: 'gem' = GEM Global Active Faults (clone), 'qfaults' = USGS Qfaults_US_Database. role: train | val (val = whole region held out for monitoring). California [-125,31.5,-116.5,41] is EXCLUDED everywhere - it is the held-out TEST region (earth_dataset_v3 key_test.lst, directly comparable to v5). Bboxes checked: every region keeps >=1.6 deg (one tile footprint) clearance from the California test tiles, so the region-level split is leakage-free by construction.
